$comment: The Honeycomb Alpha yoke, same shape as bravo-buttons.json: 'controls' is the PHYSICAL map (which button number each control is - measured by tools/Probe-HoneycombDevices.ps1 -Capture data/alpha-buttons.json, never typed in), 'map' is what each control does in the sim. 'device' tells the capture which unit to read. Names are Mark's (2026-09-06): LEFT horn has the push-to-talk trigger on the back, the 8-direction hat, a WHITE button, and the black two-way ELEVATOR TRIM switch (left, right); RIGHT horn has the RED button, a WHITE button and the black two-way AILERON TRIM switch (top, bottom). Base: MASTER ALT/BAT, AVIONICS BUS1/BUS2, BCN LAND TAXI NAV STROBE, ignition key OFF/R/L/BOTH/START. Every control starts unverified; the capture asks for each in turn, S skips. Numbering is FSUIPC's: prober minus 1, and above 31 plus 100. Latching = stays put; momentary = springs back.

PTT.label: LEFT horn: the push-to-talk trigger on the BACK of the horn

HAT_UP.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed straight UP

HAT_UP_RIGHT.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed UP-RIGHT (diagonal)

HAT_RIGHT.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed RIGHT

HAT_DOWN_RIGHT.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed DOWN-RIGHT (diagonal)

HAT_DOWN.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed straight DOWN

HAT_DOWN_LEFT.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed DOWN-LEFT (diagonal)

HAT_LEFT.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed LEFT

HAT_UP_LEFT.label: LEFT horn: the hat pushed UP-LEFT (diagonal)

ELEV_TRIM_LEFT.label: LEFT horn: the black ELEVATOR TRIM switch pushed to the LEFT

ELEV_TRIM_RIGHT.label: LEFT horn: the black ELEVATOR TRIM switch pushed to the RIGHT

AIL_TRIM_TOP.label: RIGHT horn: the black AILERON TRIM switch, the TOP button

AIL_TRIM_BOTTOM.label: RIGHT horn: the black AILERON TRIM switch, the BOTTOM button

SW_ALT.label: base: MASTER, the ALT switch, flipped ON (up) - flip it OFF first if it is on

SW_BAT.label: base: MASTER, the BAT switch, flipped ON (up)

SW_BEACON.label: base: BCN light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_LAND.label: base: LAND light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_TAXI.label: base: TAXI light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_NAV.label: base: NAV light switch flipped ON (up)

SW_STROBE.label: base: STROBE light switch flipped ON (up)

MAG_OFF.label: base: ignition key turned to OFF (turn it to R first if it is already at OFF)

MAG_R.label: base: ignition key turned to R

MAG_L.label: base: ignition key turned to L

MAG_BOTH.label: base: ignition key turned to BOTH

MAG_START.label: base: ignition key turned and HELD at START, then let it spring back

map.$comment: Empty on purpose. What each Alpha control does is Mark's decision (see notes/alpha-plan.md), taken after the physical map is measured. Same shape as the Bravo's map: press / release / when, controls as FSUIPC numbers or preset names.
